## Installation

```r
# install.packages("rehydra")
```

## Load package and data

```r
library(rehydra)
data(rehydra_data)
```

## Prepare data

```r
prepared <- prepare_rehydra_data(
  data = rehydra_data,
  time = time_days,
  genotype = genotype,
  treatment = treatment,
  replicate = replicate,
  variables = c(water_potential, stomatal_conductance),
  response_direction = "auto"
)
```

## Segment drought cycles

```r
segments <- segment_drought_cycle(
  data = prepared,
  time = time,
  value = transformed_value,
  group_by = c("genotype", "treatment", "replicate", "variable"),
  method = "auto"
)
```

## Compute basic indices

```r
damage <- damage_metrics(segments)
recovery <- recovery_metrics(segments)
resilience <- resilience_index(segments)
memory <- memory_effect(resilience, damage, recovery)
```

## Extended index families

Recovery period and total reduction, mean reduction and mean recovery rate, and
the shape of the damage and recovery curves. Each index is defined in full in
its help page; see `?recovery_period_metrics` and `?mean_reduction_metrics` for
the mathematics.

```r
recovery_period <- recovery_period_metrics(segments)
mean_reduction <- mean_reduction_metrics(segments)
shape <- curve_shape_metrics(segments)

shape[, c("deficit_auc", "t50", "recovery_rate_k", "latency")]
```

`recovery_period` is reported as `NA` with `recovery_censored = TRUE` when the
series ends before the response returns to the threshold, and `stress_detected`
flags cycles whose trough never left the baseline (control series).

## Memory across several cycles

```r
# Pairwise: every cycle against the one before it
memory_effect(resilience, cycle_test = "previous")

# Whole sequence: the average change in the index per additional cycle
memory_trend(resilience, min_cycles = 2)
```

## Everything in one table

```r
idx <- rehydra_indices(segments)
idx[, c("genotype", "cycle", "Rs", "deficit_auc", "mean_reduction", "t50")]
```

## Analyse the indices as a designed experiment

```r
fit <- rehydra_anova(resilience, response = "Rs",
                     factors = c("genotype", "treatment"))
fit$anova
fit$comparisons
```

By default one model is fitted per variable and per cycle, because repeated
cycles on the same plants are not independent. To model the cycles jointly,
move `cycle` into `factors` and declare the plant as a random intercept:

```r
rehydra_anova(resilience, response = "Rs",
              factors = c("genotype", "treatment", "cycle"),
              by = "variable", random = "plant_id")
```

Every table then comes from the mixed model; `diagnostics$model_type` and
`diagnostics$p_value_method` say which model and which degrees of freedom
produced the numbers.

## One score from several variables

```r
score <- composite_resilience(resilience, metric = "Rs")
composite_loadings(score)
```

`variance_explained` is the diagnostic that matters: a high value means the
variables agree and a single score is a fair summary, a low one means they
disagree and the composite is hiding a trade-off worth reporting per variable.

## Sub-daily series

```r
# Strip the daily rhythm before segmenting, so the trough is water stress
# and not midday.
hourly <- detrend_diurnal(prepared, time = time, value = transformed_value)
segment_drought_cycle(hourly, time = time, value = detrended)
```

## Planning the next experiment

```r
pilot <- memory_power_pilot(resilience, metric = "Rs")
memory_power(effect = 0.05, sd = pilot$sd[[1]], power = 0.8,
             design = "paired", correlation = pilot$correlation[[1]])
```

## Run the whole pipeline in one call

```r
result <- summarize_rehydra(
  data = rehydra_data,
  time = time_days,
  genotype = genotype,
  treatment = treatment,
  replicate = replicate,
  variables = c(water_potential, stomatal_conductance)
)

result$curve_shape
result$memory_trend
```

## Visualize trajectories

```r
plot_recovery_trajectory(
  data = segments,
  resilience_results = resilience,
  facet_by = c("genotype", "variable")
)

# Full series with the deficit area shaded, the trough and t50 marked
drought <- segments[segments$treatment == "Drought" &
  segments$variable == "stomatal_conductance" &
  segments$replicate == "1", ]
plot_deficit_auc(drought)

plot_curve_shape(shape)
plot_extended_indices(recovery_period, mean_reduction)
plot_memory_trend(resilience, memory_trend(resilience, min_cycles = 2))
```
